paragraphs: Chapter 1001
Episode 246. Mithra Desert Conquest Battle (11)
Tican Palace.

Jin and his companions quickly shared the newly discovered information and situation as soon as they returned. Belise and Linfa sighed in astonishment several times as they were briefed on the current state of affairs.

"… It hasn't even been a year and a half since Jin last left Laprarosa, and so much has happened in that time. Starting from the Temple of Evil Spirits, the Demon World, Demon King Zito, and up to the Enemy Clan that has recently regained its heyday. Whew, I feel so sorry that my brother had to endure all of that alone that I can't even lift my face."

In all these events, the emotions of family death, the heart of having to sever blood ties, the corruption and parting of companions, the powerless feeling in the face of the death of innocents, and a heavy responsibility to protect the world were intertwined.
Unexpected dangers were always present, and death constantly lurked nearby.
Belise and Linfa wept for a while, looking at their brother who had stood firm and finally reached the sky through it all.
"Belise... But, Jin, our brothers, and companions were together... Evil spirits... Half-brother too... was with us. Our Jin... wasn't... alone."
"Ah, that's true. I feel a little lighter now. Very good, Brother Linfa."
They also showed a tactful way of lightening the atmosphere. The companions treated the two as if they had known them for a long time.

"As I said earlier, Laprarosa has had a much quieter time compared to what Jin and his companions here have gone through. Thanks to Lingling, even when Jin was gone, time flowed normally. It was so peaceful that I felt guilty toward Jin."
"By the way, Lingling... is doing well. Half-brother... likes Lingling a lot... And Jin... talks... a lot about her. Lingling... is grumpy, but she actually... seems to like... Jin."
"Ugh! It's so frustrating. Linfa, you should meet Misol, that fast-talking demon."
"Misol...? Ah... that demon... who talks... fast..."
"It's strange; it's common for us dragons to not speak for over 20 years just in seclusion. You said your speech was slow because of a vow of silence?"
"Yes... that's right... Murakan."
"It's not on purpose, is it?"
"I want... to talk... fast too..."
The companions laughed imagining what a conversation between Linfa and Misol might look like.

"Ha ha, Murakan, don't tease our Linpa brother too much, it's scary when he gets angry. Anyway! The reconstruction of the main hall of Tusinjeon is almost complete, and the Boras brothers are also working on restoring the lost fortress. The Ban brothers seem to have told the Boras brothers some secrets about the main hall. We've heard some of it, but it's too difficult to understand. Originally, the main hall of Tusinjeon was the mothership of the Golden Fleet."
That was predicted from the moment the main hall of Tusinjeon floated into the sky during the Tawang War.
The news about Laprarosa was a continuous sequence of good news, capable of turning the tide in an instant.
However, it wasn't going to be smooth to reflect all of that into reality.
"Valeria, when did you say Dr. Quaul's liberation device will be completed?"
"He said it will be done within five days at the latest. And he'll continue to make more to prepare for damage."
Quaul was convinced that damage was inevitable while using the liberation device in the desert.
It was only natural since the device had to run in the desert for twelve hours without any shocks.
"Twelve hours... Can't we reduce that time?"
"Unfortunately, that's the best we can do for now. According to the doctor, even if we make improvements, it would be difficult to reduce it dramatically."

"But if we can secure those twelve hours, the passage between Laprarosa and Inse will be fully open. Not only the airborne fortress called the main hall of Tusinjeon but also the entire city of Laprarosa could be summoned to Inse."
"Wow, the whole city! Then we can bring all the houses and relics of our dead brothers and the mining fields, and continue to cultivate them here!"
"Dang! Belliz you rascal, I'm clearly your distant ancestor. How can you speak to me informally?"
"How can I help not being used to it? Just be friends with us, Eltiot."
"Ha, although our Qingming clan was originally a free and horizontal group... I never thought it would evolve into such a culture without hierarchy."
"Free... casual...? It doesn't look like that... Eltiot, it's too... strange."

"If you don't like being friends, be brothers. Since you're our ancestor, it might be possible without any special ceremony or test. Oh, of course, we need Ban brother's permission, so let's somehow get Laprarosa out."
"Hey! It's not that simple. As it is now, not to mention twelve hours, in fact, it's almost impossible for the device to operate safely for even one hour."
It was true.
It was incalculable how many people would be needed to maintain the device in the desert for even one hour.

"That's right. Even if we risk an attack on our base, and the alliance's maximum force goes all to the desert to push back the enemy, there are demons. They can walk up to the device and smash it, no matter how many people are guarding it, without being affected by any attack or even being restrained."
"Since the demons are summoned beings, could they naturally disappear at some point?"

"Even if they disappear, maintaining the device is still difficult. The enemies, with their superior mobility and firepower, can destroy the device with long-range bombardment alone. No matter how many layers of protection the allied superhumans put up, they can't continuously block the maximum firepower from the airborne fortresses."
"What about doing it stealthily?"

"That's also impossible, Bellize. The device to liberate Laprarosa uses wave detection technology, so it will definitely be detected by the enemy's brainwaves. Activating the liberation device outside the desert has no meaning."
Jin and his colleagues were lost in thought for a while.
No matter how much they thought, a way to maintain the device did not come to mind.
"Right now, there seem to be three possibilities."
"What are they? Brother Jin."

"First is like Bellize and Linpa brothers, more brothers come out from within Laprarosa by themselves. But this relies only on luck, and now that the enemies have started attacking the passage directly, the probability is much lower than before."
"That's true. Now, Ban brothers have to fend off bombardments unlike our time."
"Plus, the Ziefl guys will soon know about this. They won't sit still and will look for an opportunity to destroy Laprarosa. Isn't that right, little one?"
"Unusually, our Black Dragon is using that extraordinary brain properly. Yes, Ziefl will surely join in. Ban brothers will have to deal with the enemies' attack followed by Elona's magic..."
"Ah, don't worry about the Ban brothers."
Jin gave Bellize an awkward smile.
In fact, Jin and his brotherhood knew that Ban's body was not normal for a very long time, but they couldn't feel it because he was so overwhelmingly strong.
"The second is the Great Seal of the Abyss. Some of you have witnessed Talalris's Great Seal suppress Gliac for eleven hours during the Sword Emperor Temple incident."
Jin thought that perhaps the Ice Abyss, Talalris's Great Seal, might be able to hold the airborne fortresses for a while.

"That seems like a possibility, Jin. I didn't see the seal myself, but I've heard a lot about it. If I draw the power from my main body, the Abyss Lord can spread an even more powerful seal than before."
Ameris said.

"Hmph! Big snake and the Great Seal. It brings back bad memories. It's more realistic than the first, and it's something we can actively do. But even if we seal the airborne fortresses, the demons will still be a problem."
"The demon trio... honestly, there's no answer. We have no choice but to ask Shuri to negotiate as we did this time or hope that the summoning will naturally be dispelled and they will disappear."
"Then what is the third option?"

"The third is the worst-case scenario. During the battle in the desert, all the forces involved suffer significant damage, making long-term mutual containment impossible. At that point, whoever survives among us must somehow take the device to the desert. Speaking of which, we should probably rule this out altogether. Not only does it put us in danger, but the civilian casualties would be unimaginable."
"So, it would be akin to a situation leading to the end of the world."
"For now, it seems the best course of action is to trust Bigung and the big snake and prepare the second method."
The colleagues spent some time brainstorming but couldn't come up with any bright ideas.
"Jin, we will keep thinking, so go in and cool your head for a while. You never know when another battle might start, so you should rest whenever you can."
Valeria said, holding Jin's shoulder. Since the desert battle began, Jin had been fighting, moving, or conducting meetings without a moment's rest.
"I understand."
Jin left the meeting room and started walking to his room.

And as he was passing through the corridor, he happened to look out the window at the children playing with a ball. Yuria, Pinte, and Kou were lined up, throwing the ball at a small hole in the center of the garden.
'Those kids... Tikan's princess, Enya's sister, and Jett's son have all grown up this much.'
It was a simple game where the first to get the ball in the hole would win.
'What...!? Wait.'
The moment Kou's ball went into the hole, Jin felt a sudden realization as if he'd been hit on the head.
"How foolish, why didn't I think of that?"
Bang!
Jin turned back and opened the conference room door.
"Kid, why are you back? You were told to rest."
"Let's just put it inside the portal to Laplarosa!"
"What?"
"Jin?"
"What are you talking about? The historian did well to tell the little guy to go rest. The kid seems to have lost his mind."

"Let's throw the completed Laplarosa liberation device, or the blueprints and materials, into the portal. If we use the liberation device directly from Laplarosa, it will surely remain operational for about twelve hours!"
